resources.string: Bubble for dictating and inserting text in any app

Amber uses this service to show the dictation bubble and to type your dictation into the field you are writing in. For that it reads which app is in front and whether a text field has focus (to show or hide the bubble), where the keyboard is (to keep the bubble above it), and - only when inserting a dictation - the text already in that field, so the new words fit in at the cursor. None of this is stored or sent anywhere: only your recording, and with cleanup its text, goes to the engine you chose. Right after you switch on something Amber sent you to Android\'s settings for - this service, or battery use without limits - it brings Amber back to the front. Beyond that it never taps, swipes or acts for you - unless you switch on voice commands in Amber. Then it carries out only the command you just spoke: go back or home, show recent apps, notifications or quick settings, lock the screen, take a screenshot, split the screen, show the power menu, open an app or a settings page (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, sound, display, battery - it only opens them, never switches anything there), scroll, page or swipe, press play, pause or skip and change the volume, switch the flashlight, and edit the field you are writing in (delete words, select, copy, cut, paste, start a new line). For that it reads your list of apps, which parts of the screen can scroll and whether they moved - not what they show - and, only for a command that edits text, the text of the field you are in, never in a password field; all on the phone only. It never sends, pays or confirms anything for you.
